evidence: Arithmetic and small reference calculations on one lake model's columns: the waters' oxygen study's deep lakes (biosphere/ecology/lake.py as corrected after the review of 18 October and its re-check) rerun from their own settled columns with the column saved daily, with the wind's deep mixing at its central share of P10 and at its bracket. Methane is the model's debt of reduced substances in anoxic water times a methane share from Earth's low-sulphate lakes; what each overturn releases is bounded by two rules, the inventory's net rise since the last and the stock it brings up within the methane made since the last, until a methane tracer settles it; CO2 is what the water respired since it left the surface, in the lake's carbonate system; the gas saturation ratio sets them, with N2 and Ar at the surface's saturation, against the local pressure at lunar gravity. Sediment ebullition is the steady porewater balance of Bazhin as Langenegger et al. (2019) apply it, checked against Lake Soppen; bubbles rise with a contaminated-bubble drag and Froessling or Higbie transfer at lunar gravity. Oxidation and escape shares, phosphorus release rates (Nurnberg's class means, inputs), loads, Vollenweider's retention with its settling bracketed for lunar gravity, and the remedies' energy are Earth's published values; the oxygenation's bounds take the demand fixed by supply, the warm kinetics a transient beside them; the circulation's air flow is Lorenzen & Fast's guideline from Earth, with no plume computed. No lunar lake has been measured, and the model carries the methane and CO2 of its debt only in the density, as their net effect, and no phosphorus of its own.
reading_rule: Concentrations in mol/m3 (mmol/L) or umol/L as named; fluxes in mol or g per m2 of lake surface a year unless named per m2 of floor; Tg of CH4 a year Moon-wide over geography's 3.92 million km2 of rain-fed lakes. The top level holds the runs with the wind's deep mixing at its central share of P10 (0.3%), and eta_low and eta_high the same at its bracket (0.2% and 0.4%). deep_lakes are keyed deep_<target>_<band> (with _eta_low or _eta_high), each trophic state at the central renewal/supply column; methane_made is the anoxic mineralisation's methane at the low, central and high methane share (methane_made_warm_transient at the warm kinetics' transient); released_at_overturns gives what each overturn releases by each rule: net_rise, the inventory's rise since the previous overturn (a lower bound), and stock, the stock the overturn brings up within the methane made since the previous overturn (an upper bound). saturation_ratio is the dissolved gases' pressure over the local pressure: 1 is the bubble point. hazard_map gives years for an isolated hypolimnion to reach it at its floor, earth_at_25c under Earth's own air; deepest holds the 1,925 m lake's fifty years from an oxygenated start, which turns over (overturn_events) and so gathers no gas, with the years it would take isolated by the hazard map's rule. survival lists by depths_m the share of a bubble's methane reaching the air. methane.<target>.traits gives each trophic state's bubbles and, under by_release_rule, its flux by each rule with low/central/high brackets and moon_tg_yr_giants_on_the_oxycline with the lakes deeper than 1,000 m sending up only what crosses a lasting oxycline; air.<rule> gives the steady state and dimming with the lakes in the ledger, each pair the low- and high-cost ends of the domain synthesis. phosphorus is keyed by settling (earth, aggregates at the square root of g/6, stokes at g/6), loads in g P m-2 a-1; tp_with_internal_mg_m3 adds the internal load outside the retention (Nurnberg 1984), for floors drawing on a stock beyond their steady state, and tp_with_internal_at_steady_state_mg_m3 holds it to phosphorus.without_retention, what flows in over the hydraulic load, the most a lake keeps at steady state whatever its floors release; burial keeps it below that. remedies per km2 of lake: oxygenation's bounds at the demand and at three times it, as the devices' stirring raises it, and warm_transient beside them.
